title: remember_feedback_id's stale-lock takeover can let two writers in, and its finally unlinks a lock another writer holds
goal: a writer takes over a stale feedback.ids lock only when the lock it renames is the stale one it saw, and releases only a lock it holds, so no id is lost when a holder stalls past the stale age

def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):

import os, pathlib, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import ql_capture as q
d = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
(d / "spool").mkdir()
spool = d / "spool" / "tools-2026-10-24.jsonl"
lock = spool.parent / (q.FEEDBACK_IDS_NAME + ".lock")
real, fired = os.replace, []
def replace(a, b, *r, **k):
    if not fired:
        fired.append(1)
        os.unlink(lock)
        lock.write_text("other")  # this writer stalled past the stale age: another writer holds the lock now
    return real(a, b, *r, **k)
os.replace = replace
try:
    q.remember_feedback_id(spool, "FB-0123abcd")
finally:
    os.replace = real
assert fired, "the check never saw the writer replace the record under its lock"
assert lock.exists() and lock.read_text() == "other", ("a writer released the lock another writer holds", lock.exists())

lock.write_text("")
old = time.time() - 3600
os.utime(lock, (old, old))
q.FEEDBACK_IDS_LOCK_WAIT_S = 0.3
real, fired = os.stat, []
def stat(p, *a, **k):
    r = real(p, *a, **k)
    if str(p) == str(lock) and not fired:
        fired.append(1)
        os.unlink(lock)
        lock.write_text("")  # another writer took the stale lock over: the file there is a live lock now
    return r
os.stat = stat
try:
    got = q._take_ids_lock(lock)
finally:
    os.stat = real
assert fired, "the check never saw the writer read the stale lock"
assert got is False, ("a writer that saw a stale lock took over the live lock another writer holds now", got)
